reason: The README clearly identifies the plugin as a terminal user interface for sustained interactive conversations with DeepSeek Harness agents, including session controls and tool-execution visualization.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体提供支持流式输出、会话控制和工具执行展示的终端聊天界面。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness agents with a terminal chat interface featuring streaming output, session controls, and tool-execution displays.

capabilities: Provides a terminal-based interactive chat interface for DeepSeek Harness agents
Renders streaming Markdown, reasoning sections, code, diagrams, and tool execution cards
Supports session control, queued follow-up messages, model selection, permission presets, and workflow panels
Supports local file references, session export, provider configuration, and terminal editor integration
